# Oakridge Dental — Full Site Content for LLMs

> Comprehensive, comfortable dentistry for the whole family in Farmington, Utah.

## About
Oakridge Dental is a comprehensive family and cosmetic dental practice in Farmington, UT. We serve Farmington, Kaysville, Centerville, Fruit Heights, Layton, Davis County.

## Key facts
- **Address:** 1838 N 1075 W, Ste 200, Farmington, UT 84025
- **Phone:** (385) 600-6715
- **Rating:** 4.9★ from 770 Google reviews
- **Insurance:** Most major dental insurance plans accepted
- **Financing:** Cherry financing available; in-house Family Dental Health Program membership
- **Hours:** Monday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM; Tuesday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM; Wednesday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM; Thursday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM; Friday 8:00 AM–2:00 PM; Saturday-Sunday Closed

## Doctors
### Dr. Brian Call, DDS
Dr. Call grew up in Bountiful, Utah, where he learned two things early on: the value of community and how to shovel snow like a pro. Inspired by his great-grandfather, Dr. Call knew from a young age he wanted to follow in his footsteps.
He has been practicing dentistry in Davis County for over 20 years and is passionate about helping patients feel confident in their smiles. From general and cosmetic dentistry to dental implants , Invisalign® , sleep apnea treatment and professional teeth whitening , Dr. Call combines advanced technology with personalized care to create long-lasting results. He believes in honest communication, a calm presence and treating every patient like a friend. At Oakridge Dental, he is proud to help people of all ages feel at home while receiving top-quality dental care.
What he loves most about Oakridge Dental is the people. The team is skilled, compassionate and full of personality, creating an environment where patients feel comfortable and cared for.
Outside the office, Dr. Call enjoys skiing, hiking, camping and making his family laugh. He is a big fan of musical theater and may even sing during your appointment if you ask. He is also known for his Racing Challenge, any patient up for a foot race might just earn free teeth whitening.

### Dr. Candice Fresques, DDS
Dr. Candice Fresques grew up in Davis County, Utah, who always had a desire to help other people. She majored in mathematics at Westminster College, and subsequently received honors from the University of Pittsburgh School of Dental Medicine. During dental school, she provided care to the underprivileged of Pittsburgh and Honduras and later performed a residency at Salt Lake City VA, where she refined her techniques while taking care of veterans.
With over nine years of dental experience, Dr. Fresques is well known for her gentle demeanor, clinical expertise and the ability to calm patients. She is excited to be part of the Oakridge Dental team and likes working with such a caring, high-functioning team.
Outside of the office, Dr. Fresques is an outdoor enthusiast, lover of hiking and camping, yogi at heart, and enjoys time with her husband, two children and two mischievous puppies. She is here to make your dental experience positive, comfortable and personalized, every step of the way.

### Dr. Dave Jackson, DDS
Dr. David Jackson was raised in Murray, Utah, and has always been interested in how the body functions. His interest in the medical field naturally narrowed to dentistry, and after shadowing several dentists, he was certain he had made the correct choice. He graduated from dental school in 2002 and began his career as a dentist in the U.S. Air Force. After several years in the military, he entered private practice in Utah and has been practicing general dentistry for over 20 years. He has a special interest in newer technologies of digital dentistry.
At Oakridge Dental, Dr. Jackson enjoys the high-tech equipment and compassionate team that allow him to deliver efficient, quality care. He is committed to building trust through effective communication and making patients feel involved and at ease throughout their visit.
Outside of the office, he likes to hike, camp, ski and get outdoors every chance he gets. Dr. Jackson also makes a trip to Guatemala annually to provide dental care through humanitarian work, and he has been working hard to learn Spanish so he can communicate better with the people he serves.
His wished-for superpower, if he had his choice, would be perfect communication, so that every patient would fully understand their care and be reassured every step of the way.

### Dr. Preston Vance, DDS
Dr. Vance was raised in North Salt Lake, Utah, and yes, he still has the school spirit (and probably an old Wildcats hoodie to prove it). He knew he wanted to be “the tooth guy” since he was 5 years old. While other kids were dreaming about superheroes or astronauts, he was busy brushing his stuffed animals’ teeth and drawing molars in crayon.
After several years practicing dentistry in Arizona, Dr. Vance moved back to Utah to be closer to family, the mountains and his favorite condiment: fry sauce. He loves that dentistry combines science, creativity and meaningful human connection. Helping patients feel at ease, improving their smiles and using the latest technology to deliver high-quality care is what drives him every day.
Dr. Vance’s favorite part of Oakridge Dental is the upbeat, team-focused atmosphere. It is a place where patients feel known, valued and genuinely cared for the moment they walk in. He is proud to be part of a team that is passionate about creating healthy, confident smiles in a place that feels more like a community than a clinic.
Outside the office, you can find him running, snowmobiling, backpacking and pulling out ridiculous dance moves just to hear his son laugh. He was born in Anchorage, Alaska, is fluent in Spanish and firmly believes a little humor goes a long way when it comes to creating a comfortable dental experience.

## Services (full detail)

### General Dentistry

#### Brushing & Flossing
URL: https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/brushing-and-flossing
Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT provides personalized brushing and flossing education for patients of all ages, teaching proper technique to prevent cavities and gum disease. Call (385) 600-6715 to book a checkup.
The right technique makes all the difference — we'll show you how to brush and floss effectively for a healthier smile.

## Why Patients Choose Oakridge Dental

- Proper technique
- Healthier gums
- Prevent decay

## What to Expect

Our caring team makes brushing & flossing comfortable and straightforward. We'll explain everything in plain language, answer your questions, and tailor treatment to your needs.

We welcome patients from across Farmington, Kaysville, Centerville, Fruit Heights, Layton, and Davis County, Utah.

**FAQs:**
- **How often should I brush and floss my teeth?** You should brush at least twice a day for two minutes each time and floss once daily. At Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT, our team provides personalized brushing and flossing guidance for patients of all ages to help prevent cavities and gum disease.
- **What is the correct way to brush my teeth?** Use a soft-bristled toothbrush with a pea-sized amount of fluoride toothpaste, brushing in gentle circular motions across all tooth surfaces, including back molars and the gumline. Our Farmington dental team will demonstrate proper technique during your visit.
- **Why is flossing important if I already brush?** Flossing reaches the tight spaces between teeth and under the gumline that a toothbrush cannot clean, removing plaque that causes cavities and gum disease. At Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT, we teach effective flossing techniques tailored to your needs.
- **Can poor brushing and flossing affect my overall health?** Yes. Poor oral hygiene is linked to systemic conditions because oral infections can contribute to broader health issues. Regular brushing and flossing, plus checkups at Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT, protect both your smile and your overall health.
- **At what age should children start flossing?** Children should begin flossing as soon as two teeth touch, typically around age 2-3, with parental help. Our Farmington team offers child-friendly hygiene coaching to build lifelong habits.
- **How do I book a checkup at Oakridge Dental?** Call Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT at (385) 600-6715 to schedule a checkup. We serve Farmington, Kaysville, Layton, Ogden, Centerville, Woods Cross, and Salt Lake City.

#### Dental Cleanings & Exams
URL: https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/dental-cleanings-exams
Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT offers comprehensive dental cleanings and exams for all ages, removing plaque and tartar and providing early detection of dental issues. Schedule at (385) 600-6715.
Routine cleanings and comprehensive exams are the foundation of a healthy smile, removing plaque and tartar and catching problems early.

## Why Patients Choose Oakridge Dental

- Remove plaque and tartar
- Catch issues early
- Personalized prevention

## What to Expect

Our caring team makes dental cleanings & exams comfortable and straightforward. We'll explain everything in plain language, answer your questions, and tailor treatment to your needs.

We welcome patients from across Farmington, Kaysville, Centerville, Fruit Heights, Layton, and Davis County, Utah.

**FAQs:**
- **How often should I get a dental cleaning and exam?** Most patients should get a professional cleaning and exam every six months. At Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT, our hygienists customize the schedule based on your age, oral health history, and risk factors.
- **What happens during a dental cleaning and exam?** A cleaning includes removal of plaque and tartar, teeth polishing to remove surface stains, fluoride treatment, and a comprehensive exam of your mouth, teeth, and gums. Oakridge Dental in Farmington uses professional-grade tools for a thorough, comfortable visit.
- **Do dental cleanings hurt?** No, dental cleanings are generally painless. Our Farmington team prioritizes comfort and offers a gentle, anxiety-easing approach to make your cleaning a stress-free experience.
- **Why are regular exams important?** Regular exams allow early detection of cavities, gum disease, and other issues before they become serious or costly. This proactive care at Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT reduces the risk of dental emergencies.
- **Are cleanings and exams suitable for children?** Yes. Oakridge Dental in Farmington provides cleanings and exams for patients of all ages, from children and teenagers to adults, with age-appropriate care and education.
- **How do I schedule a cleaning at Oakridge Dental?** Call Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT at (385) 600-6715 to book your cleaning and exam. We welcome patients from Farmington, Kaysville, Layton, and surrounding communities.

#### Dental Sealants
URL: https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/dental-sealants
Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT applies quick, painless dental sealants to protect children's and adults' molars from cavities and decay. Book at (385) 600-6715.
A thin protective coating painted onto the grooves of back teeth to shield them from decay — quick and painless.

## Why Patients Choose Oakridge Dental

- Protects cavity-prone teeth
- Painless, no drilling
- Great for kids and adults

## What to Expect

Our caring team makes dental sealants comfortable and straightforward. We'll explain everything in plain language, answer your questions, and tailor treatment to your needs.

We welcome patients from across Farmington, Kaysville, Centerville, Fruit Heights, Layton, and Davis County, Utah.

**FAQs:**
- **What are dental sealants?** Dental sealants are a thin plastic coating applied to the chewing surfaces of back teeth to protect against cavities and decay. Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT offers quick, painless sealant application for children, teens, and adults.
- **Are dental sealants only for children?** No. While sealants are commonly applied to children's permanent molars, adults without decay or fillings in their molars can also benefit. Oakridge Dental in Farmington provides sealants for patients of all ages.
- **How long do dental sealants last?** Dental sealants can last for many years with proper care, making them a cost-effective way to prevent tooth decay. Our Farmington team checks sealants during your regular exams.
- **Is the sealant procedure painful?** No, applying sealants is quick and painless. At Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT, the tooth is cleaned, a gel is applied and rinsed, then the sealant is painted on and hardens almost instantly.
- **Do sealants replace brushing and flossing?** No. Sealants add protection but should be combined with daily brushing, flossing, and regular cleanings. Our Farmington team will guide you on a complete prevention plan.
- **How do I book a sealant appointment?** Call Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT at (385) 600-6715 to schedule sealants for you or your child. We serve Farmington and nearby Utah communities.

#### Emergency Dental Care
URL: https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/emergency-dental-care
Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT provides prompt emergency dental care for toothaches, knocked-out teeth, and urgent issues, with sedation options for comfort. Call (385) 600-6715 right away.
Toothaches and dental injuries don't wait — call us right away and we'll work to see you as soon as possible.

## Why Patients Choose Oakridge Dental

- Same-day care when possible
- Fast relief from pain
- Care for broken or knocked-out teeth

## What to Expect

Our caring team makes emergency dental care comfortable and straightforward. We'll explain everything in plain language, answer your questions, and tailor treatment to your needs.

We welcome patients from across Farmington, Kaysville, Centerville, Fruit Heights, Layton, and Davis County, Utah.

**FAQs:**
- **What counts as a dental emergency?** Severe toothaches, knocked-out teeth, broken or cracked teeth, lost fillings, and signs of infection are dental emergencies. Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT provides prompt treatment to relieve pain and prevent further damage.
- **What should I do if my tooth gets knocked out?** Keep the tooth moist (in milk or saliva), avoid touching the root, and seek care immediately. Call Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT at (385) 600-6715 right away for urgent treatment.
- **Can you treat dental emergencies the same day?** Oakridge Dental in Farmington aims to provide fast relief and stabilize urgent issues promptly. Call (385) 600-6715 as soon as a dental emergency occurs so our team can assess and treat you quickly.
- **Do you offer sedation for emergency dental visits?** Yes, our Farmington team offers sedation options to alleviate anxiety and pain during emergency treatment, ensuring a comfortable, reassuring experience.
- **How do I relieve a severe toothache before my appointment?** Rinse with warm salt water, use a cold compress, and take over-the-counter pain relief as directed, then contact us. Call Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT at (385) 600-6715 for immediate guidance.
- **What areas does your emergency care serve?** Oakridge Dental serves emergency patients in Farmington, Kaysville, Layton, Ogden, Centerville, Woods Cross, and Salt Lake City, UT. Call (385) 600-6715 for urgent care.

#### Fluoride Treatment
URL: https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/fluoride-treatment
Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT offers quick, painless fluoride treatments that strengthen enamel and prevent decay for children and adults. Schedule at (385) 600-6715.
A quick professional fluoride application that strengthens enamel and helps reverse the earliest signs of decay.

## Why Patients Choose Oakridge Dental

- Strengthens enamel
- Reduces sensitivity
- Fast and easy

## What to Expect

Our caring team makes fluoride treatment comfortable and straightforward. We'll explain everything in plain language, answer your questions, and tailor treatment to your needs.

We welcome patients from across Farmington, Kaysville, Centerville, Fruit Heights, Layton, and Davis County, Utah.

**FAQs:**
- **What is a fluoride treatment?** A fluoride treatment is a quick, painless preventive procedure that applies concentrated fluoride to strengthen tooth enamel and reduce decay risk. Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT offers fluoride treatments for patients of all ages.
- **How often should I get fluoride treatments?** Most patients benefit from fluoride treatments during their regular six-month checkups, though those at higher cavity risk may need them more often. Our Farmington team customizes frequency to your needs.
- **Are fluoride treatments safe for children?** Yes. Fluoride treatments are especially beneficial for children and teenagers whose teeth are still developing and more susceptible to cavities. Oakridge Dental in Farmington provides age-appropriate fluoride care.
- **Do adults need fluoride treatments?** Yes, especially adults with a history of cavities, gum disease, or tooth sensitivity. Fluoride strengthens enamel and reduces sensitivity for patients at Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT.
- **Does fluoride treatment hurt?** No, fluoride treatment is quick and painless. The solution, gel, foam, or varnish is applied directly to clean teeth at Oakridge Dental in Farmington in just a few minutes.
- **How do I schedule a fluoride treatment?** Call Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT at (385) 600-6715 to add a fluoride treatment to your checkup. We serve Farmington and surrounding Utah communities.

**FAQs:**
- **What is PRF therapy in Farmington, UT?** PRF (Platelet-Rich Fibrin) therapy at Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT is a natural treatment that uses your body's own blood to accelerate healing. A small blood sample is spun in a centrifuge to concentrate platelets and growth factors, which are then applied to the treatment area to speed recovery and tissue regeneration.
- **Is PRF therapy safe?** Yes, PRF therapy is very safe because it uses your own blood, eliminating the risk of allergic reaction or disease transmission. Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT offers this minimally invasive treatment for patients of all ages.
- **What are the benefits of PRF therapy?** PRF therapy offers reduced swelling, decreased risk of infection, and faster healing times after dental procedures. At Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT, Dr. Brian Call uses PRF to enhance recovery following surgery, extractions, and implant placement.
- **Does PRF therapy hurt?** PRF therapy involves a simple blood draw similar to a routine lab test, so discomfort is minimal. Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT prioritizes patient comfort throughout the process.
- **How long does PRF healing take?** PRF therapy accelerates the body's natural healing, often leading to noticeably faster recovery than standard procedures. Contact Oakridge Dental in Farmington at (385) 600-6715 to learn how PRF can benefit your treatment.

#### Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP)
URL: https://oakridgedentalsmiles.com/services/platelet-rich-plasma
Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT offers PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) therapy, a safe, non-surgical treatment using your own blood to accelerate healing and reduce inflammation. Provided by Dr. Brian Call for patients of all ages.
PRP harnesses your body's natural healing factors to enhance recovery after surgical procedures.

## Why Patients Choose Oakridge Dental

- Enhances recovery
- Natural healing factors
- Improves results

## What to Expect

Our caring team makes platelet-rich plasma (prp) comfortable and straightforward. We'll explain everything in plain language, answer your questions, and tailor treatment to your needs.

We welcome patients from across Farmington, Kaysville, Centerville, Fruit Heights, Layton, and Davis County, Utah.

**FAQs:**
- **What is PRP therapy in Farmington, UT?** PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) therapy at Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT uses your own blood to promote healing. Blood is drawn, spun in a centrifuge to concentrate platelets, and injected into the treatment site to stimulate natural healing and reduce inflammation.
- **How is PRP different from PRF therapy?** PRP and PRF both use your own blood to aid healing, but PRF (fibrin) is spun at lower speeds and releases growth factors more gradually, while PRP (plasma) is a liquid concentrate often injected directly. Dr. Brian Call at Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT can recommend the best option for your needs.
- **Is PRP therapy safe?** Yes. Because PRP uses your own blood, there is a very low risk of allergic reaction or infection. Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT offers this non-surgical treatment for patients of all ages.
- **What are the benefits of PRP therapy?** PRP therapy speeds healing, reduces pain and inflammation, and supports tissue regeneration. Oakridge Dental in Farmington, UT uses PRP to improve recovery after dental procedures.
- **Does PRP therapy require surgery?** No, PRP therapy is non-surgical. It begins with a simple blood draw from your arm. Contact Oakridge Dental in Farmington at (385) 600-6715 to learn more.
